title: Compatible strict henselizations with integral geometric residue maps
statement: Let g:T→S be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let k,k′ be separably closed fields [def-pc-separably-closed], σ:Spec k→S and τ:Spec k′→T integral geometric points [def-weil-geometric-point], and ι:Spec k′→Spec k satisfy ι≫σ=τ≫g. Integral means that each point factors through the residue field of its image by an integral field homomorphism [def-weil-residue-field]. Let Ω be an algebraically closed field and ν:Spec Ω→Spec k′ any field-spectrum morphism. Set s=ν≫ι≫σ and t=ν≫τ. There exist strictly henselian local rings A,B [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], isomorphisms eA:Spec A≅S_(s) and eB:Spec B≅T_(t) to the strict henselization schemes [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], a local homomorphism φ:A→B, and universal homeomorphisms ρA:Spec k→Spec κA and ρB:Spec k′→Spec κB. Writing jA=eA≫j_s and jB=eB≫j_t for the canonical structural maps [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map], rA,rB for the closed-point maps, and i0 for the residue-field map induced by φ, one has Spec φ≫jA=jB≫g, ρA≫rA≫jA=σ, ρB≫rB≫jB=τ, and ρB≫i0=ι≫ρA. This result is purely geometric and contains no sheaf or cohomology.

proof.text: Apply strictHenselizationResidue at s and t: the canonical colimits are strictly henselian and their residue fields are the relative separable closures of the image residue fields inside Ω. Take their spectra for eA and eB.

A separable polynomial over an image residue field splits in k or k′ because those fields are separably closed. Hence its roots in Ω already lie in the corresponding embedded field. Factor the relative separable-closure embeddings through k and k′ to obtain ρA and ρB. The integral geometric-point factorizations make these fields algebraic over their base residue fields; an algebraic extension of a separably closed field is purely inseparable. The spectra of the resulting purely inseparable extensions are integral, surjective and universally injective, hence universal homeomorphisms.

The residue factorizations of strictHenselizationResidue give the equalities with σ and τ. Apply strictHenselizationFunctoriality to s=t≫g using hι. It gives φ and the structural square. The induced residue embeddings commute after their injective embeddings into Ω, so cancel those embeddings to get ρB≫i0=ι≫ρA.
